---
title: "Simulation Recovery Checks"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r loadings}
loadings_path <- "../outputs/tables/07_sim_lowrank_recovery_loadings.csv"
if (file.exists(loadings_path)) {
  loadings <- read_csv(loadings_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  ggplot(loadings, aes(truth_value, mean, color = parameter)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_point() +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

```{r variances}
variance_path <- "../outputs/tables/07_sim_lowrank_recovery_variances.csv"
if (file.exists(variance_path)) {
  variances <- read_csv(variance_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  ggplot(variances, aes(truth_value, mean, color = parameter)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_point() +
    theme_minimal()
}
```
